m.t: Si hubiera visto a alguien, es posible que pudiera reconocer a esa persona.
m.e: If I had seen someone, then it is possible that I could recognize said person.

m.t: Hay que reconocer que todo se lo debemos a ella.
m.e: It must be recognized that we owe it all to her.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2266448 by marcelostockle; English translation #2266449 by marcelostockle

m.t: Es más fácil reconocer los errores de los demás que los nuestros.
m.e: It's easier to recognize other people's mistakes than our own.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10616189 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #5756441 by Hybrid

m.t: No se puede reconocer el hoy si no se quiere ver el ayer.
m.e: You can't recognize today if you don't want to look at yesterday.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5011986 by Shishir; English translation #9770477 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Lo puedo reconocer incluso de entre una multitud.
m.e: I can recognize him even in a crowd.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #745598 by ventana; English translation #258862 by CK

m.t: El primer paso para resolver un problema es reconocer que existe.
m.e: The first step in solving any problem is recognizing there is one.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6133882 by Adelpa; English translation #6126082 by Adelpa

m.t: Deberías reconocer que en sus palabras hay algo de verdad.
m.e: You should recognize that there is some truth to his words.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8395150 by arh; English translation #8416157 by cromwellt

m.t: Hubo muchos que no lo pudieron reconocer con ese disfraz.
m.e: There were many who couldn't recognize him in that disguise.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5015570 by albrusgher; English translation #320345 by CM

m.t: ¿Puedes reconocer a la persona en esta fotografía?
m.e: Can you recognise the person in this picture?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1881837 by Khelm; English translation #1077657 by keira_n

m.t: Un héroe a menudo es solo una persona sin la habilidad de reconocer el peligro.
m.e: A hero is often just a person who doesn't have the ability to recognise danger.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1510495 by marcelostockle; English translation #1510493 by voxbubnya

m.t: Él tenía miedo de reconocer que no lo sabía.
m.e: He was scared to admit that he didn't know.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1744937 by Shishir; English translation #1737282 by Spamster

m.t: Hay que reconocer que no fue la mejor comida que he probado.
m.e: Admittedly, it wasn't the best meal I've ever eaten.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1712822 by teskmon; English translation #1616543 by eastasiastudent

m.t: Quizá sea hora de reconocer que os equivocasteis de bando.
m.e: Maybe it's time to admit you chose the wrong side.

m.t: He de reconocer que tenías razón.
m.e: I have to admit that you were right.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2402786 by wallebot; English translation #10697753 by CK

m.t: Nadie quiso reconocer el error.
m.e: No one wanted to acknowledge the mistake.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7841537 by Seael; English translation #8972781 by Nylez

m.t: Lo más extraño es que nadie me reconoce.
m.e: The strangest part is that no one recognizes me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1750324 by marcelostockle; English translation #1750327 by marcelostockle

m.t: Vamos a ver si alguien reconoce la cara.
m.e: We'll see if anyone recognizes the face.

m.t: Alguien que reconoce el talento en bruto cuando lo ve.
m.e: Someone who recognizes raw talent when he sees it.

m.t: Se reconoce a un árbol por sus frutos.
m.e: A tree is known by its fruits.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1695457 by marcelostockle; English translation #3763374 by cromwellt

m.t: «¿Cómo sabías que era alemán?» «Se reconoce con facilidad por tu acento.»
m.e: How did you know I'm German? "It's easy to tell with your accent."
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10038783 by Shishir; English translation #10042713 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Es por sus herramientas que se reconoce al buen obrero.
m.e: It's by his tools that a good worker is recognized.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #991348 by hundo; English translation #10326181 by LimeGreenTeknii

m.t: Veremos si él me reconoce o no.
m.e: We will see whether he will recognize me or not.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #872366 by japegon; English translation #871281 by CM

m.t: Uno reconoce al artesano por su obra.
m.e: One recognizes the craftsman by his work.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2533106 by marcelostockle; English translation #1366783 by sacredceltic

m.t: ¡Sería mejor si él tampoco te reconoce!
m.e: It would be best if he does not recognise you either!

m.t: ¿Reconoce usted a este hombre?
m.e: Do you recognise this man?

m.t: ¡Nadie me reconoce incluso mirándome!
m.e: No one recognises me or is even looking at me!

m.t: - ¿Reconoce alguno de ellos?
m.e: - Recognise any of them?

m.t: Aunque reconoce que te saqué todo eso en tan solo 20 minutos.
m.e: Though you have to admit I got all of that out of you in a mere 20 minutes.

m.t: Ella no reconoce que está equivocada.
m.e: She doesn't admit that she is wrong.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #339795 by tatoerique; English translation #314594 by CK

m.t: Tom reconoce que no es divertido.
m.e: Tom acknowledges it's not fun.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #13032341 by Eremon; English translation #4529678 by CK

m.t: Él reconoce su culpa.
m.e: He recognizes his fault.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2052222 by marcelostockle; English translation #3479776 by hantol01

m.t: Tom reconoce que fue derrotado.
m.e: Tom acknowledges that he was defeated.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #922577 by Shishir; English translation #37021 by CK

m.t: ¿A lo mejor hay alguien más a quien reconoces?
m.e: Is there perhaps someone else here you recognize?

m.t: Este hombre es tu padre, por si no lo reconoces.
m.e: This man's your father, in case you don't recognize him.

m.t: ¿Reconoces a alguna de estas chicas como amigas de tu hermana?
m.e: Do you recognize any of these girls as your sister's friends?

m.t: Pero reconoces que Lee no recuerda qué pasó esa noche.
m.e: But you do recognize that Lee doesn't remember what happened that night.

m.t: Necesito que me digas si reconoces alguno de los individuos.
m.e: I need you to tell me if you recognize any of the individuals.

m.t: Quiero que me digas si la reconoces.
m.e: I want you to tell me if you recognize her.

m.t: Me reconoces del cine y la televisión.
m.e: You recognize me from movies and television?

m.t: Me pregunto si reconoces a este hombre.
m.e: I wonder, do you recognise this man?

m.t: ¿Un lugar que reconoces, quizás?
m.e: A place you recognise, perhaps?

m.t: ¿Reconoces nuestra canción, querido?
m.e: You recognise our song, my dear?

m.t: ¿Reconoces a tu papá?
m.e: You recognise your dad? Yeah?

m.t: Siempre reconoces a todos.
m.e: You always recognise everyone.

m.t: La reconocí en el momento en que salió del bus.
m.e: I noticed her the moment she got off the bus.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1166076 by marcelostockle; English translation #308123 by CK

m.t: No reconocí el número, pero pensé que quizá cambiaste de teléfono.
m.e: I didn't recognize the number, but I thought maybe you switched phones.

m.t: No te reconocí con tu ropa de civil.
m.e: I didn't recognize you in your civilian clothes.

m.t: Algunos los reconocí en ese entonces, otros los reconocí hasta ahora.
m.e: Some I recognized then. Some I only recognize now.

m.t: Te reconocí por tu foto en la pared.
m.e: I recognize you from your picture on the wall.

m.t: Y reconocí su voz tan claramente como si fuera de día.
m.e: And I recognized his voice as clear as day.

m.t: Al verlo en la foto, lo reconocí de inmediato.
m.e: Having seen him in the picture, I recognized him at once.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #855479 by opor; English translation #265300 by \N

m.t: Tengo un mensaje de un número que no reconocí.
m.e: I got a text from a number that I didn't recognise.

m.t: Y cuando me di vuelta, lo reconocí.
m.e: And when I turned round, I recognised him.

m.t: Sí, creo... que te reconocí.
m.e: Yeah, I...thought I recognised you.

m.t: Lo reconocí de inmediato.
m.e: I recognised him immediately.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1565848 by Alba; English translation #1565750 by sundown

m.t: Reconocí el error de mi proceder.
m.e: I recognized the error of my ways.
